explanation: States the k = 1 (two-colour) case ω₁² → (ω₁·ω, 3)², attributed in the docstring to Erdős–Hajnal [EH74]. The page does not mention this result (it only cites Baumgartner's MA result for ω₁·ω → (ω₁·ω, 3)²), and [EH74] is not in the reference list, so I could not verify the attribution. The statement itself is a correct specialisation.
